extracted.name: Yogurt Glaze
extracted.description: This is a quick and yummy glaze to put on top of cupcakes or regular cake!
instruction_lines: Whisk together yogurt, vanilla extract, and confectioners' sugar in a bowl until smooth. Refrigerate for at least 30 minutes before spreading on a cake or cupcakes.
